clusters.headline: Cyprus closer than ever to joining Schengen but political hurdles relating to the Green Line and British Sovereign Base Areas remain
clusters.summary: The European Commission says Cyprus is ready to join the Schengen Area. Yet questions relating to the island's division and British military bases could still complicate its path to Europe's border-free travel zone.

clusters.headline: Madagascar: A Year After Madagascar's Gen Z Protests and Rajoelina's Ouster, Little Promised Change
clusters.summary: [RFI] A year after Madagascar's then-president Andry Rajoelina fled the country following more than two weeks of youth-led protests, the military-backed transition has yet to deliver on its promise of a political "refoundation".

clusters.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says the murders are a "stain on our national conscience".

clusters.headline: Nigeria: My Nigerian Pastor Inspired Me to Speak Out On Christian Persecution - - Nicki Minaj
clusters.summary: [Vanguard] American rapper Nicki Minaj has said her Nigerian pastor inspired her to speak out about the alleged persecution of Christians in Nigeria, urging celebrities and social media influencers to use their platforms to draw attention to the situation.
